name: Copycat
description: A block that takes on the look of another block.

pages.title: Copycat
pages.text:
A **copycat** block takes on the look of any block you apply to it, so you can make slices, layers, panels, doors, fences or even cogwheels and shafts in any material.\
\
Copycats+ supplies them here; Create: Connected's own copycats are switched off. Create Propulsion has copycat wings.
